visual_restraint_rules: camera locked off or near-locked; no camera moves that imply a walkthrough
no products, tools, weapons, or machinery parts in frame
no text, labels, logos, or brand marks
empty central staging area so R3F foreground content owns the frame
no fake scientific instrumentation — nothing that reads as a measurement device
low contrast, muted palette; motion slow enough to loop after trim
